claims.evidence: The witness identifies an industrial machine with cylinders and rails consistent with blow molding, but cannot confirm the specific function.

claims.claim: Used in production to make pet plastic bottles
claims.evidence: The witness did not see the machine in operation or any finished bottle output.

risks.risk: The machine may have critical electronic or PLC failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the control panel powered on and navigating through the software menus.

risks.risk: The mechanical pneumatic or hydraulic systems may be seized or leaking.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine completing one full dry-cycle (opening and closing the mold assembly).
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a complete mechanical overhaul

risks.risk: The machine may be a low-capacity or obsolete model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's data plate showing the model, year, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-value generic entry-level model

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate/data plate.
Video of the machine powered on and performing a dry cycle.
Close-up photo of the PLC/control screen while active.
Photos of any included molds or the air compressor unit.
response.reason: The witness could not identify the brand, model, or specifications, which are essential for valuing industrial equipment. Without the nameplate data, even a worst-case valuation is speculative.
